# Qenlo

> Embedded filtered vector search for native applications. Measured before marketed.

Qenlo is a research-grade embedded vector database for durable, exact, metadata-filtered retrieval. It runs in-process with canonical local records and optional CPU, WGPU, and tensor execution.

- Website: https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/
- Documentation: https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/
- Repository: https://github.com/a3ro-dev/qenlo

## Getting started

- [Overview](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/README.md): Core introduction, boundaries, and documentation index
- [Quickstart](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/quickstart.md): Build from source, create collections, insert, search, and reopen
- [Core concepts](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/concepts.md): Canonical state, eligibility, exactness, and routing boundaries
- [Collection browser](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/browser.md): Terminal user interface (TUI), local web UI, and Tauri desktop inspector
- [Use cases](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/use-cases.md): Where Qenlo fits and where it does not
- [Trade-offs](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/trade-offs.md): Memory costs, CPU baseline realities, and routing guidance
- [Feature matrix](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/feature-matrix.md): Implemented, optional, and unverified capabilities

## SDKs and bindings

- [Rust API](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/sdks/rust.md): Core asynchronous Rust client, options, and usage
- [Python SDK](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/sdks/python.md): Python bindings, bulk buffer ingestion, and optional TorchIndex
- [TypeScript SDK](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/sdks/typescript.md): Node.js native FFI bindings with TypeScript type safety
- [Go driver](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/sdks/go.md): cgo bindings for Go services and command-line tools
- [Kotlin SDK](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/sdks/kotlin.md): JNA bindings for JVM applications
- [Swift SDK](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/sdks/swift.md): Swift bindings over the shared C ABI

## Architecture and storage

- [Architecture specification](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/architecture.md): CoreStore, transaction lifecycle, lock protocols, and visibility
- [.qn storage format](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/qn-format-v1.md): Binary file layout, little-endian specs, and atomic exchange semantics
- [Recovery policy](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/recovery-policy.md): Deterministic recovery, fail-closed boundaries, and operator contracts
- [GPU search design](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/gpu-design.md): Custom WGSL scoring, selection pipelines, chunking, and memory arenas
- [CUDA backend todo](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/cuda-backend-todo.md): Entry gates and engineering requirements for a native CUDA backend

## Research and verification

- [Device lab](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/device-lab.md): Multi-platform test runner, profiles, and telemetry handling
- [Measured results (2026-08-28)](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/results-2026-08-28.md): Native Windows benchmark run data and comparisons
- [Verification record](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/verification.md): Verification record, test outcomes, and audit trail
- [Implementation status](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/implementation-status.md): Engineering roadmap status and hardware gates
- [CI and release map](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/ci.md): GitHub Actions workflows and release sequence
- [Package publishing](https://a3ro-dev.github.io/qenlo/docs/publishing.md): Multi-registry publication pipeline
